| Normalize Mini Cooper Convertible to Cooper | domain:cars | active | cars | cars | 3 |
| A brand that appears only after 'for' / 'compatible with', or a parent-company word, is a reference, not the maker; the item's own brand wins (electronics: 'atrend-bbox ... for Ford'; cars: 'Chrysler Attitude' -> Dodge). | global | active | cars, electronics | - | 2 |
| settle short single names (Loop B V1) | domain:fragrance | active | fragrance | - | 1 |
| Short model codes (H17, 'Jac 2') need a context guard before they are used as models; allowing them blindly hurts precision. | domain:cars | active | cars | electronics | 2 |
| Codes that differ only in their last characters (CE250A / CE250X) are different products unless the listing says otherwise. | - | dropped | - | cars, electronics | 5 |
| Sizes and specs (capacities like 64gb, focal ranges like 18-55, displacement, gearbox) are never model or version names. | domain:electronics | active | electronics | electronics | 4 |
| strip hair travel mist fine with; +eau de perfume | domain:fragrance | active | fragrance | - | 1 |
| A structured field (model / part number) confirms an identifier the title also states, even when the title states it late (after 'with ...'); title-only tokens are weaker. | domain:electronics | active | electronics | electronics | 2 |
| typed child when the form differs | - | dropped | - | fragrance | 1 |

| url rung | domain:fragrance | active | fragrance | - | 1 |
| validator-checklist-from-mistakes | - | dropped | - | cars | 2 |
| The validator places bundles, kits, multipacks and refurbished items on the product they contain; extras never change the model. | domain:electronics | active | electronics | - | 1 |
| The validator must read the listing's own structured fields (model / version / brand fields), not only the title; it was the largest validator gain in both electronics (v1->v3) and cars (v2). | global | active | cars, electronics | - | 2 |
